results.notes:
Created tests/test_notifications.py via cursor-agent. Note: `git_diff` returned empty output, which is consistent with the new file being untracked (git diff shows no changes for untracked files); the file itself was reported changed by cursor-agent at tests/test_notifications.py.

The file contains pytest unit tests for the two public functions in src/notifications.py (`send_email` and `send_sms`), patching `src.notifications.logger` so no real logging/IO occurs. Expected complete content:

```python
"""Unit tests for src/notifications.py.

These tests patch the module-level logger so no real logging side effects
occur and assertions on emitted messages remain deterministic.
"""

from unittest.mock import patch

from src.notifications import send_email, send_sms


@patch("src.notifications.logger")
def test_send_email_returns_true(mock_logger):
    assert send_email("a@b.com", "Hello", "Body") is True


@patch("src.notifications.logger")
def test_send_email_logs_expected_message(mock_logger):
    send_email("a@b.com", "Hello", "Body")

    mock_logger.info.assert_called_once()
    logged = mock_logger.info.call_args[0][0]
    assert "a@b.com" in logged
    assert "Hello" in logged
    assert logged == "Sending email to a@b.com: Hello"


@patch("src.notifications.logger")
def test_send_sms_returns_true(mock_logger):
    assert send_sms("+15551234567", "Your code is 1234") is True


@patch("src.notifications.logger")
def test_send_sms_logs_expected_message(mock_logger):
    send_sms("+15551234567", "Your code is 1234")

    mock_logger.info.assert_called_once()
    logged = mock_logger.info.call_args[0][0]
    assert "+15551234567" in logged
    assert "Your code is 1234" in logged
    assert logged == "Sending SMS to +15551234567: Your code is 1234"


@patch("src.notifications.logger")
def test_return_values_are_literal_true(mock_logger):
    assert send_email("x@y.com", "S", "B") is True
    assert send_sms("000", "M") is True
```

Run with: `python -m pytest tests/test_notifications.py -v`.

results.notes: Created tests/test_admin.py covering the public API of src/admin.py. Both public functions (admin.dashboard and admin.audit_log) are imported via `from src import admin` and their external dependencies are patched on the admin module namespace (src.admin.validate_token, src.admin.check_permissions), so no real auth/storage/network code runs; get_user/create_order/charge/send_email are left untouched by these functions and asserted unused where relevant. Coverage: dashboard returns the exact stats dict {total_users: 1000, total_orders: 5000, revenue: 250000.00}; dashboard calls validate_token once with the token and check_permissions('admin','dashboard:read') once; dashboard propagates ValueError from validate_token and does not call check_permissions in that case; dashboard propagates PermissionError from check_permissions after token validation; audit_log returns action/details/timestamp ('2026-08-20T00:00:00Z'); audit_log calls validate_token exactly once with the token; audit_log propagates ValueError from validate_token. Tests use unittest.mock.patch context managers/decorators and are deterministic and isolated with no I/O. Note: `git diff` returned empty output because tests/test_admin.py is a new untracked file, though cursor-agent reported it as the single changed path (tests/test_admin.py).

results.notes: Added JSDoc documentation comments to all six exported interfaces in src/client/types.ts (CreateOrderRequest, Order, ChargeRequest, ChargeResult, LoginRequest, Session), plus per-property comments. Documented non-obvious constraints: `token` as an auth credential, `quantity` as a positive integer unit count, `amount` as non-negative minor units (e.g. cents), optional `currency` as ISO 4217 defaulting to the account/platform default, and `password` sent only over TLS. No runtime behavior or type definitions were changed — the diff contains only inserted comment lines.
